news.title: 受AI热潮驱动，Marvell与Lumentum宣布1150亿美元合并——《纽约时报》
news.snippet: [AI热潮推动Marvell与Lumentum宣布1150亿美元合并，强化数据中心光互连与算力基础设施。]
news.raw_snippet:
The transaction between the two Silicon Valley companies, which includes Lumentum’s debt, would rank as the largest ever by value between publicly held tech companies.

Marvell makes an array of chips for networking and A.I. The 31-year-old company has been growing rapidly by acquisition since Matthew Murphy joined it as chief executive in 2016. [...] The deal, the companies said, reflects a realization that needs for A.I. computing power have far outstripped the abilities of individual chips. Companies such as Nvidia now sell entire racks full of special-purpose A.I. processors that are designed to work together like a single system. [...] Supported by

# Driven by A.I. Boom, Chipmakers Announce $115 Billion Merger

Marvell and Lumentum said they were combining, in a major bet on a technology, known as optical networking, that is increasingly being used in A.I. data centers.

Marvell Technology on Monday announced a $115 billion stock swap to buy Lumentum Holdings, in a major bet that a technology known as optical networking will be crucial to the build-out of data centers for artificial intelligence.

news.title: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch：一个人与AI Agents如何改变工作
news.snippet: [Vercel CEO认为，随着AI Agents能力增强，未来一人借助多智能体即可完成过去需要团队的复杂工作。]
news.raw_snippet:
It's that AI agents are increasingly capable of performing connected tasks, making decisions within defined boundaries, and working across different business functions.

Consider a solo founder launching a software company.

Instead of hiring separate specialists to create a prototype, develop the website, test functionality, and manage infrastructure, that entrepreneur can increasingly coordinate AI tools to help execute those activities. [...] The founders who benefit most from AI may be those who can articulate what success looks like, evaluate trade-offs, and recognize when automated work falls short.

AI can accelerate execution. It cannot automatically supply a founder's purpose, accountability, or understanding of customers.

## 6. Build Something So Good That Customers Choose It

There's another danger in an era when entrepreneurs can generate products faster than ever.

Speed can create the illusion of progress. [...] What if the next trillion-dollar company doesn't need thousands of employees? Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch believes AI agents are rewriting the rules of entrepreneurship—and creating an extraordinary opportunity for ambitious founders.

For decades, building a massive company followed a familiar formula: raise capital, hire talented people, expand operations, and invest heavily in technology.

The bigger the ambition, the bigger the organization needed to become.

news.title: 让智能可运营：京东CEO许冉谈将企业AI转化为业务价值
news.snippet: [京东CEO许冉表示，企业AI正加速融入实体场景，通过运营智能将技术转化为可衡量的业务价值。]
news.raw_snippet:
AI can also be used in physical environments thanks to increasing innovation in embodied AI, in relatively controlled environments, including warehouse navigation and moving goods – with Xu expecting its role to expand further as perception, reasoning and execution improve. [...] Xu says the business used more than 70 AI agents across its value chain in the first half of 2026, including applications in product data, matching supply and demand, procurement and fulfilment.

Yet the larger opportunity, Xu argues, lies in joining work that has previously been fragmented. Marketing content can be generated more efficiently within one department, while it’s possible now to use AI to connect customer demand to product selection, inventory forecasting and fulfilment. [...] All that of course requires changes within the company itself, too, from responsibilities to information flows. Xu draws a parallel between AI and electrification: businesses gained more when they redesigned production around a new capability than when they simply substituted equipment within an existing process.

Her argument for AI suggests that organizations need to examine what work should become once information and decisions are able to move differently.
